hints.title: No waitForStart() needed
hints.content: Unlike LinearOpMode, you don't call `waitForStart()`. The lifecycle is managed for you: `init()` runs once at INIT, then `loop()` runs repeatedly after START. Each callback is short and returns quickly.

hints.title: Declare hardware fields at class level
hints.content: Declare `DcMotor driveMotor;` as a field (outside any method) so both `init()` and `loop()` can access it. Initialize it inside `init()` with `hardwareMap.get()`.

hints.title: Negating the Y axis
hints.content: Joystick Y is -1.0 when pushed fully up (forward). Negate it so pushing up gives positive power: `driveMotor.setPower(-gamepad1.left_stick_y);`
